dialogues.jp:
「また、なんで俺は休日の校舎をうろついてる
　んだかな……」
dialogues.en: "Why am I wandering around the school on a Sunday......?"
dialogues.text: "Why am I wandering around the school on a Sunday......?"

dialogues.jp: ひっそりと静まり返った廊下をひとり歩く。
dialogues.en: I walked down the quiet corridor.
dialogues.text: I walked down the quiet corridor.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なにぶつくさ言いながら歩いてるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you mumbling about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you mumbling about?"

dialogues.jp: 突然、杉並が目の前に現れる。
dialogues.en: Suginami appeared suddenly.
dialogues.text: Suginami appeared suddenly.

dialogues.jp:
どこから出てきたんだ？　ここは廊下のど真ん
中だぞ。
dialogues.en: Where did he come from? I was in the middle of the corridor.
dialogues.text: Where did he come from? I was in the middle of the corridor.

dialogues.jp: 「それ以前に、なんでお前がここにいる」
dialogues.en: "Why are you here?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you here?"

dialogues.jp: 人のことは言えないが、今日は日曜日だぞ！
dialogues.en: I can say the same thing about myself, but it's Sunday!
dialogues.text: I can say the same thing about myself, but it's Sunday!

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「フッ……実はある筋から、とある情報を入手
　してな」
dialogues.en: "Hehehe...... I got some information from a source."
dialogues.text: "Hehehe...... I got some information from a source."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「俺には、むちゃくちゃ｛あいまい／曖昧｝な情報元に聞こえ
　るが？」
dialogues.en: "It doesn't sound reliable to me."
dialogues.text: "It doesn't sound reliable to me."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「安心しろ、情報は確かだ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, the source is reliable."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, the source is reliable."

dialogues.jp:
制服を着て学園にいるというのに、目の前の杉
並が場違いな存在にみえる。
dialogues.en: He looked out of place even though he was wearing a uniform.
dialogues.text: He looked out of place even though he was wearing a uniform.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「実はこの学園の七不思議のひとつに“開かず
　の扉”というのがあってな。そいつの調査に
　きたのさ」
dialogues.en:
"There are seven wonders of the school. I came to
investigate one of them, 'The Forbidden door'."
dialogues.text:
"There are seven wonders of the school. I came to
investigate one of them, 'The Forbidden door'."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、まて。信じるか信じないかは、まずは
　現場を見てから決めようではないか」
dialogues.en:
"Wait. Let's check the door before we decide to believe or
not."
dialogues.text:
"Wait. Let's check the door before we decide to believe or
not."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……場所はわかってるのか？」
dialogues.en: "......You know where it is?"
dialogues.text: "......You know where it is?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。どうしても鍵が開けられない扉が、１
　つあってな。恐らくそれだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. There's only one door I've never been able to unlock.
I think that's it..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. There's only one door I've never been able to unlock.
I think that's it..."

dialogues.jp: 鍵が開けられないとは？
dialogues.en: It can't be unlocked?
dialogues.text: It can't be unlocked?

dialogues.jp:
「でも鍵が開けられないんじゃ、行ってもしょ
　うがないだろう」
dialogues.en: "But it's no use if you can't unlock the door."
dialogues.text: "But it's no use if you can't unlock the door."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「かったるいと言うのはまだ早いぞ。……見ろ」
dialogues.en: "Don't say 'what a pain' yet. ......Look."
dialogues.text: "Don't say 'what a pain' yet. ......Look."

dialogues.jp: 杉並がポケットからひとつの鍵を取りだす。
dialogues.en: He took out a key from his pocket.
dialogues.text: He took out a key from his pocket.

dialogues.jp: 「それが？」
dialogues.en: "Is that it?"
dialogues.text: "Is that it?"

dialogues.jp: 家の鍵とは違う、黒光りするものを見つめる。
dialogues.en: The key looked darker and shinier than regular house keys.
dialogues.text: The key looked darker and shinier than regular house keys.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。まず間違いないだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Yup. Only this key was hidden in a different place from the
rest of the keys. This must be it."
dialogues.text:
"Yup. Only this key was hidden in a different place from the
rest of the keys. This must be it."

dialogues.jp: 間違いないって……。
dialogues.en: It was hidden......?
dialogues.text: It was hidden......?

dialogues.jp: 「いったいどこで手に入れたんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "Where did you get it from?"
dialogues.text: "Where did you get it from?"

dialogues.jp:
そう聞くと、杉並は意味深な笑みを浮かべて、
『学長がどうしてもと言うのでな』などとのた
まわった。

dialogues.en: Is he joking? The safe's more like the forbidden door......
dialogues.text: Is he joking? The safe's more like the forbidden door......

dialogues.jp: ……深くは考えないでおこう。
dialogues.en: (I want to cut-off my friendship with him!)
dialogues.text: (I want to cut-off my friendship with him!)

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ここだ」
dialogues.en: "Here it is."
dialogues.text: "Here it is."

dialogues.jp:
そのドアは、学長室や来客室などがある、普段
学生がこないところにあった。
dialogues.en:
The door was located near the principal's office and the
conference room where the students hardly ever come.
dialogues.text:
The door was located near the principal's office and the
conference room where the students hardly ever come.

dialogues.jp: 「たしかに、それらしい雰囲気はあるな……」
dialogues.en: "It does have a strange look, it could be it......"
dialogues.text: "It does have a strange look, it could be it......"

dialogues.jp:
｛いか／厳｝つい、頑丈そうなドアを前に、俺の表情も微
妙に引き締まる。
dialogues.en:
My face got serious too at the presence of the hard looking
door.
dialogues.text:
My face got serious too at the presence of the hard looking
door.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、試してみるか」
dialogues.en: "Let's see."
dialogues.text: "Let's see."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が鍵穴に鍵を差し込み、半回転させる。
dialogues.en: Suginami inserted the key and turned it.
dialogues.text: Suginami inserted the key and turned it.

dialogues.jp: カチャリ――
dialogues.en: Click...
dialogues.text: Click...

dialogues.jp: よく聞く、鍵のあく音が微かに耳にとどく。
dialogues.en: I heard the door unlock.
dialogues.text: I heard the door unlock.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「開けるぞ」
dialogues.en: "Shall we?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並の言葉に、黙って頷く。
dialogues.en: I nodded to him.
dialogues.text: I nodded to him.

dialogues.jp: ギィィィィィ――
dialogues.en: Creeeeek......
dialogues.text: Creeeeek......

dialogues.jp: 夏への扉？
dialogues.en: The door to summer?
dialogues.text: The door to summer?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「帰るか……」
dialogues.en: "Let's go home......"
dialogues.text: "Let's go home......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ゲーセンでもよって行くか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you wanna go to the arcade?"
dialogues.text: "Do you wanna go to the arcade?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いいねぇ。何にする？」
dialogues.en: "Sounds great. What do you wanna play?"
dialogues.text: "Sounds great. What do you wanna play?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「フッ……俺たちに銃以外のなにがあるという
　んだ」
dialogues.en:
"Humph...... What else do we have besides the shooting
game?"
dialogues.text:
"Humph...... What else do we have besides the shooting
game?"

dialogues.jp: 互いに構えあう。
dialogues.en: We both held the shooting guns.
dialogues.text: We both held the shooting guns.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「行くか」
dialogues.en: "Shall we?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we?"

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、銃を片手にギャングどもをブチのめし、
街を救った……。
dialogues.en: We beat all the gangs, and saved the town......
dialogues.text: We beat all the gangs, and saved the town......

dialogues.jp: ◆異次元への扉◆
dialogues.en: ◆The door to another dimension◆
dialogues.text: ◆The door to another dimension◆

dialogues.jp:
何故か、杉並に出会った。休日の学園だっての
に。まあ、お互い様ではあるが……。
dialogues.en:
I ran into Suginami. What's he doing at the school on
Sunday? I guess I could say the same thing for me too......
dialogues.text:
I ran into Suginami. What's he doing at the school on
Sunday? I guess I could say the same thing for me too......

dialogues.jp:
杉並曰く、開かずの扉の鍵をゲットしたらしい。
何をやっているんだか。ともかく、二人でその
扉へと向かった。
dialogues.en:
He claimed he'd managed to get the key to the forbidden
door. What kind of thing was he up to? Anyways, we headed to
the door.
dialogues.text:
He claimed he'd managed to get the key to the forbidden
door. What kind of thing was he up to? Anyways, we headed to
the door.

dialogues.jp: 鍵を差し込み、開く。
dialogues.en: He turned the key to open the door.
dialogues.text: He turned the key to open the door.

dialogues.jp: うそ〜ん。
dialogues.en: No way.
dialogues.text: No way.
